svg.title: The Pipe — a skater running four airs on a halfpipe
svg.desc: Side profile of a halfpipe at sunset. A skater oscillates between the two copings, gaining speed through the transition and going 4 feet 10 inches above the lip, doing a melon grab, a method air, a 360 and an indy grab. Motion timing is derived from energy conservation and ballistic flight.

g.text: LIP 12.5 MPH · HANG 1.06 S · APEX 4′10″ · G = 32.2 FT/S²
½MV² = MGH · µ≈0 · SEAMLESS LOOP 8.904 S
FOUR AIRS · FRONT DOWN, FAKIE BACK
